🐰 Welcome to +1 Speed Hospital Escape! 🏥
⚡ Every step = +1 Speed — train and become insanely fast!
🐾 Escape strange patients, creepy nurses & dangerous obstacles 😱
💨 Unlock 10+ adorable & spooky animal morphs with step bonuses!
🔥 Collect powerful multipliers and unlock new stages
👥 Race your friends and other players to reach the finish first
🏆 Earn Wins, progress further & climb the leaderboards
🎧 ASMR-inspired footsteps, hospital ambience & satisfying progression ✨
